fields.v: Evaluates; secondary: Proposes an evaluation method — repository mining: qualitative content analysis of 91 project-level agent rule files (e.g. CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md) collected at Google in late July 2025, yielding a normative taxonomy of desirable agent behaviours (4 expectations / 15 attributes) as a basis for evaluations beyond correctness

fields.doubt: O artigo não diz a que agentes se destinam os 91 ficheiros de regras da Google nem avalia nenhuma ferramenta (p. 1-2). Decide entre Yes (nenhuma ferramenta avaliada) e Partly (se os agentes forem da Google).
